create_SGD_optimizer: create a custom SGD optimizer with momentum, weight decay, and Nesterov support for PyTorch models
run_SGD_step_with_visiable: run a single optimization step updating only parameter groups whose names appear in the visiable list
build_SGD_with_nesterov_momentum: build an SGD optimizer with Nesterov momentum enabled for faster convergence on deep learning models
test_SGD_weight_decay: test the SGD optimizer with weight decay applied as an L2 penalty during parameter updates
review_SGD_step_closure: review the SGD step method that optionally accepts a closure to reevaluate the model and return loss
